fatal_blockers: Proposal 7 is dead on arrival: classical Nullstellensatz degree lower bounds (Grigoriev 1998 on Tseitin; Buss–Pitassi-style bounds) show unsatisfiable 3CNF families require certificate degree Omega(n), so any fixed-degree moment linearization is unsound as a reduction and any sound one has exponentially many coordinates. Obstruction G is not open here; it is classically closed against this mechanism. KILL.

Proposal 6's needed cosystolic support-amplification is precisely PCP-style gap amplification, which the oracle brief forbids; the proposal itself concedes this. Additionally F_2 cochain dichotomies do not control integer multiples or approximate Euclidean cheats (N) and no route from support expansion to CVP radii exists (V). KILL.

Proposal 4 collides with a structural fact: lattices are closed under negation, so semigroup/nonnegativity membership cannot be enforced by linear lattice constraints, and the 'moat' penalty has no proof of dominating signed Graver moves; the proposal's own likely-death states this. Toolchain (Normaliz/4ti2) is also unaudited. KILL unless a mutation proves the moat bound locally first.

Proposal 5 re-instantiates the Generation-1 slack-annihilation kill (S): a defect d_i tagged by B^i is cancelled by a carry of magnitude ~d_i/B, so lexicographic separation collapses at O(1) penalized carry cost; it also requires an integral defect functional that does not yet exist. Not runnable before Proposal 1 delivers that functional. DEFER/KILL in current form.

Proposal 3 attacks none of the live blockers (P, O, G): it rebuilds a local gadget layer already exactly certified in Generation 3 and its own likely-death (legal one-hots charged equally, constant ratio) would leave the campaign exactly where it is. DEPRIORITIZE.

Proposal 2 is sequenced behind unfinished prerequisites: no hash-verified survivor identity (P), no extracted integral defect functional (E), and no two-clause overlap evidence (O); its q-divisible-defect blind spot (wraparound) is unaddressed. DEFER until Proposal 1's experiment reports.
evidence: Only Proposal 1 discharges the gen-3 gate mandate exactly: it asserts set/hash equality between the reconstructed and Generation-2-emitted survivor matrices before use (closing P), then composes one certified representative across two clauses sharing one variable with all polarities and references, deciding zero-defect feasibility exactly by Smith/Hermite form plus a norm-<=8 enumeration. Both branches are informative: an integer or rational zero-defect harmful point kills private-row composition immediately; exact infeasibility certificates license exactly one follow-up (Proposal 2's q=5 wraparound test).

Proposal 1's mechanism map is honest against the current obstructions: no free clause slack (S survives Gen-1's kill mode), only the 18 exactly certified three-row survivors are used (E), private rows plausibly but unprovenly address O, and its stated likely-death (fractional/signed occurrence values zeroing all expensive rows) is exactly what the SNF test detects (N).

Proposal 1's asymptotic language ('distance Omega(W) over O(sqrt(n)) completeness radius') is aspiration, not evidence; nothing in the packet supports any scaling law (G) or CVP basis/target/radius accounting (V). The CONTINUE licenses only the two-clause bounded experiment, not the equality-forest reduction.

Status files consistently label all prior results FINITE: Gen-1 is an exact kill of slack-form RS amplification (27 vs 19), Gen-2 is a bounded 18-survivor fact, Gen-3 is exact rational emptiness of 126 constant-size fibers. No supplied claim promotes these to a hardness lemma, and this review does not either.

Provenance remains open right now: the Gen-3 verifier reconstructed survivors from a structural characterization without ingesting the Gen-2 output; any experiment consuming these matrices before the hash comparison would certify possibly-wrong objects. Proposal 1 is the only proposal that makes this check mandatory and first.

No search results or external documents were consulted; the classical citations used (Nullstellensatz degree lower bounds, lattice negation-closure) predate and are independent of any off-limits material.
